stage: Minimal deployable alpha Student: direct progress versus frozen actor q_PD alignment

memory.contract: Only past/current completed actual force XYZ FIFO and original frozen-normalized actor deployment inputs. No alpha/teacher state, event counter, anchor, active, global time, onset, direction label, previous_z or future reference. FIFO initialized with zeros, no padding mask or length feature.

network.normalization: Training-only per-feature center/std with std floor0.1, shared A/B; force divided by5N before this transform

optimization.B: Mean squared original q_PD error across all29 joints, divided by fixed(0.1rad)^2; action errors also reported
optimization.parity: Identical saved MLP initialization for every A/B run; full fits restart from that initialization after single-trajectory diagnostics. Exactly shared sampled batches, identical updates, no early stopping/best checkpoint. Wall and actual work reported separately.

final_checkpoints.selection: fixed update2000, never chosen using physical or regression results

physical.command: Same two verified norm16 endpoints and original spherical path; Student alpha at50Hz, no hand gate/rate limiter/IK/PD modification
physical.common_state: Original full t3 standing snapshot; anchor from existing no-force reference at each actual onset; never a Student input
physical.reused_controls: Prior standing/clock/contact traces for two dev onsets, no-contact, pulse and old4.6s; same source/model/physics, no new fits
physical.new_jobs: A/B on two devs+negative controls+old4.6 regression, then final5.4 standing/clock/unchanged teacher/A/B.15 full branches. No final condition loaded by fit.
physical.shadow_teacher: Unchanged gate may label Student visited observations for diagnosis only; its alpha/action never enters Student or plant and no aggregation training this phase

evaluation.report: All XYZ/force/cap, timing, shoulder/waist/root, support, continuity, recovery, teacher-gain recovery; no claim of exact zero alpha from sigmoid or general conditioning

stop: Original physical safety boundaries; finite gradients and contract checks. Model/inference always CUDA. Preserve all failed launches, no reward/net/gate tuning after results; if closed-loop fails diagnose saved traces and propose at most one future aggregation, do not train again automatically.
